content: दारुण {%a.%} [दॄ-णिच्-उनन् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 53</ls>] .²1 Hard, rough; शोकदारुणाः (वाचः) <ls>U. 3. 34</ls>. .²2 Harsh, cruel, ruthless, pitiless; मग्येव विस्मरणदारुणचित्तवृत्तौ <ls>Ś. 5. 23</ls>; पशुमारणकर्मदारुणः <ls n="Ś.">6. 1</ls>; दारुणरसः ‘of cruel resolve or nature’; <ls>U. 5. 19</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 270</ls>. .²3 Fierce, terrible, frightful; प्रसादसौम्यानि सतां सुहृज्जने पतन्ति चक्षूंषि न दारुणाः शराः <ls>Ś. 6. 28</ls>. .²4 Heavy, violent, intense, poignant, agonizing (grief, pain <ab>&c.</ab>); हृदयकुसुमशोषी दारुणो दीर्घशोकः <ls>U. 3. 5</ls>. .²5 Sharp, severe (as words). .²6 Atrocious, shocking. .{@-णः@} .²1 The sentiment of horror (भयानक). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .{@-णम्@} .²1 Severity, cruelty, horror, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 The harsh, unfavourable constellations मृग, पुष्य, ज्येष्ठा and मूल; <ls>Mb. 13. 104. 28</ls>.
